platform.target: mobile HTML5 Canvas2D landscape; mouse/keyboard secondary
platform.backgroundPolicy: pause all game clock, physics, crafting, hunger, cooldown and RNG when hidden; attempt checkpoint

delivery.workingMode: static HTTP origin or itch.io HTML5 upload; file:// not guaranteed because modules/fetch may be blocked
delivery.artifact: ZIP with dist/index.html, JavaScript bundle, local PNG/atlas/audio, data or inlined JSON; no external servers or accounts
delivery.development: ES modules in src + deterministic build script; do not assume a live CDN or remote sprites
delivery.optional: standalone one-file index.html if build tooling can reliably embed all assets; not a replacement for validated ZIP release

uiPausePolicy.fishing: UI_FISHING is active gameplay; fish timer and world sim run as one single game clock; stop world motion for player, not whole game
uiPausePolicy.closingOverlay: restore prior simulation state exactly, never apply offline catch-up

mainGameLoopOrder: Input sampling and per-frame UI actions
Commit completed world actions and transactional inventory moves
Advance single in-game clock and triggered day slices

Queue autosave/checkpoints from immutable simulation snapshot
Camera culling, sprite render ordering, lighting, UI draw

rng.worldSeed: uint32 assigned once on New Game
rng.persistence: persist state/counter of gameplay streams; no Date.now or unseeded Math.random for gameplay rewards
rng.instanceIds: stable persisted or deterministic source-prefixed ids
rng.rerollPrevention: all rolls claimed exactly once by stable claimKey and transaction ledger

ownership.uiSendsCommands: all UI actions validated centrally; authoritative result event drives UI
ownership.save: single current writer per save slot
